subject: WaveCart renewal: convert burst credits to committed monthly & rate reshuffle
messages:
From: Evan Price <evan.price@wavecart.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@wavecart.com>, WaveCart Finance <billing@wavecart.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + burst conversion question

Hi Mina —

We’re lining up our budget for next fiscal and I wanted to check the feasibility of converting a majority of our unused burst credits into committed monthly capacity for the hosted API. Usage spiked in March but since then we’ve plateaued and the finance team prefers predictable monthly billing.

High level: can we move ~2.5M tokens/month from the current burst bucket into a committed band at a slightly lower per-token rate, and also tighten the per-minute rate limit to avoid noisy spikes? We’re targeting a go-live for the new plan by July 1.

Can you send a proposal and a short ops runbook so our infra team can sign off on rate limits?

Thanks —
Evan
Evan Price
Head of Platform
WaveCart Inc.

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Evan Price <evan.price@wavecart.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Renewal + burst conversion question

Thanks Evan — this is doable and we can structure it to preserve latency SLAs while making billing predictable. Summary of what I’m proposing (attached is a short proposal + pricing workbook):

- Convert 2.5M tokens/month from the burst pocket into a new Committed Band ("Committed Band C") for a 12-month term. Blended per-token rate will be 12% below current burst-overage pricing.
- Per-minute rate limit: introduce a graduated soft-throttle that enforces a 20% lower sustained TPS for background/async routes, but keeps user-facing chat routes at the current SLO. This prevents noisy batch jobs from causing short-term throttling for interactive traffic.
- Migration timing: agreement signed by 2027-06-15, technical rollout in a staged window 2027-06-20 to 2027-06-30, billing effective 2027-07-01.
- Ops runbook: we’ll provide a 1-page rate-limit table + suggested retry/backoff policy and a preflight traffic validation script.

Action items:
1) Evan: confirm PO path and whether WaveCart finance needs invoice cadence changed to monthly-in-advance.
2) Mina: I’ll send a redlineable contract + the MAP_pricing_breakdown.xlsx and a DocuSign link.
3) Karthik / Marissa: we’ll schedule a 30-min technical sync with WaveCart infra next week (propose 2027-06-08).

I attached WaveCart_proposal_v2.pdf with the numbers; open to a 24-month term if you want a deeper discount.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Sr. Account Exec, Growth
Redwood Inference
+1 415-555-1198

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Evan Price <evan.price@wavecart.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 08:25:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Renewal + burst conversion question

Copying pricing details into thread for clarity. Evan — quick table excerpt from MAP_pricing_breakdown.xlsx:  

- Current: Hosted burst overage: $0.00030 / token (on surge)
- Proposed Committed Band C (12mo): $0.000265 / token (2.5M token monthly commit)
- Soft-throttle window: sustained 60s window for async routes; enforced per-customer token cap = 1.2x committed rate for burst (grace)
- Invoice cadence: monthly in arrears (standard) — can change to monthly in advance if WaveCart provides PO by 2027-06-10

Notes: the per-minute request rate we enforce is adjustable by route. For the technical sync, we recommend WaveCart expose a list of heavy endpoints so we can scope a route-level throttle and preserve the chat route SLO.

Mina: I’ll prepare the canary rollout checklist and hand off to Marissa for provisioning.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Sales
Redwood Inference

Mina / Karthik —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. A few clarifications from finance/legal:
- Lina: we need a short amendment that shows the 12-month committed band, effective date, and the new per-token unit price. Prefer DocuSign.
- Billing: WaveCart prefers monthly in advance. We can provide an umbrella PO that covers Q3/Q4 if needed.
- Rate limits: our infra wants the exact per-route throttle numbers to validate against our traffic shaping. Can you supply that ahead of the technical sync?

Confirming we can hit the PO deadline (internal) by 2027-06-10. If you can get the amendment to us by EOD 2027-06-04, we’ll route it to legal.

Evan
